programme.title: U opasnoj zoni - vulkani Francuske
programme.desc: Klasifikovan kao deo svetske baštine UNESKO-a od 2018. godine, venac Pui se pridružio relativno malom klubu teritorija nazvanih po svojoj izuzetnoj geološkoj vrednosti. U centru Francuske, zapadno od Klermon Ferana, nalazi se više od 80 vulkana sa neverovatnim i raznovrsnim oblicima, na pojasu dužine 40 i širine 3 kilometra. Poput reklame za mineralnu vodu, ovaj predeo odiše spokojem. Zapravo, na mnogim sličnim mestima, čovečanstvo je često imalo koristi od boravka u blizini vulkana. Ali rizik je uvek da do erupcije može doći u bilo kom trenutku bez upozorenja.

programme.desc: Svako godišnje doba donosi svoje izazove, trijumfe i trenutke zadivljujuće lepote, jasno stavljajući do znanja zašto je Veliki koralni greben i krhak i vitalan za budućnost planete.

programme.title: Vulkanska ostrva - konstantna pretnja
programme.desc: Oko 10% današnje svetske populacije živi u blizini nekog od približno 1 500 aktivnih vulkana na planeti. Francuski regioni na Karibima i u Indijskom okeanu nisu izuzetak _ 70 000 ljudi živi u podnožju vulkana La Sufrijer na Gvadelupu, a 780 000 njih na ostrvu Reunion. Takođe, većina stanovništva Majota živi na izuzetno uskom pojasu zemljišta kome preti podvodni vulkan. Opservatorije u Francuskoj, kao i u mnogim zemljama širom sveta, neprekidno prate vulkansku aktivnost kako bi pokušale da predvide katastrofalne erupcije i izmeste stanovništvo na bezbedno.

programme.title: Rečna čudovišta
programme.desc: Ekstremni ribolovac Džeremi Vejd je u potrazi za rečnom ribom koja voli ljudsko meso. Koristeći forenzičke metode, Džeremi pokazuje kako su ova rečna čudovišta programirana da ubiju.

programme.title: Licem u lice
programme.desc: Fotograf i ronilac Rodolf Ginjar putuje svetom kako bi se suočio licem u lice sa predatorima, uključujući orke, krokodile i ajkule i provodi vreme sa ljudima koji žive pored ovih divova.

programme.title: Skriveni vulkan - erupcija iz ambisa
programme.desc: Vulkan Hunga Tonga-Hunga Hapai proradio je sa snagom od preko 60 miliona tona TNT-a 15. januara 2022. godine. To je najsnažnija eksplozija ikada zabeležena na planeti do danas. Talasi visoki kao zgrada od šest spratova opustošili su pacifičku državu Tongu za nekoliko minuta, ostavljajući zemlju u ruševinama. Sada se pridružujemo timu istražitelja koji pokušavaju da reše misterije ovog vulkana. Zašto je on izazvao tako snažnu erupciju, kako je stvorio tako razorni cunami i, što je najvažnije od svega, da li je isto moglo da se dogodi sa drugim vulkanima na našoj planeti?

programme.title: Jeloustoun, američka tempirana bomba
programme.desc: Na našoj planeti ima supervulkana čija erupcija je jača od bilo koje moći koju je čovek ikada upoznao. Jedan od najmoćnijih supervulkana na planeti nalazi se u Sjedinjenim Američkim Državama. Za njega se smatra da postoji već dve milijarde godina i on je do sada imao tri super erupcije, koje su se okvirno pojavljivale na svakih 700 000 godina. Kada bi Jeloustoun ponovo proradio, kakve bi to posledice imalo po čovečanstvo? Delovi severnoameričkog kontinenta bili bi opustošeni, a život na zemlji bio bi poremećen vekovima nakon toga. Kako onda naučnici mogu da predvide opasnost na jednom od najlepših, ali i najopasnijih mesta na svetu? Uz pomoć vodećih stručnjaka na ovom polju, ovaj dokumentarac predstaviće sve potencijalne scenarije erupcije Jeloustouna.

programme.title: Raselina Sveti Andreja: trka sa vremenom
programme.desc: Kalifornija je jedna od najaktivnijih seizmičkih zona na svetu. Raselina Sveti Andreja je mesto spajanja dve tektonske ploče i proteže se duž San Franciska i Los Anđelesa. Duga je 1 300 kilometara, široka je 140 kilometara i trenutno je fenomen koji izaziva najviše pažnje na svetu. Ali zbog čega je tako i na koji način ona ugrožava lokalno stanovništvo? Naučnici tvrde da bi jačina raseline mogla da dostigne broj 9, što je najveća jačina po Rihterovoj skali. Kako se naučnici pripremaju za najgore i kako da predvide nepredvidivo?

programme.title: U opasnoj zoni - vulkani Francuske
programme.desc: Klasifikovan kao deo svetske baštine UNESKO-a od 2018. godine, venac Pui se pridružio relativno malom klubu teritorija nazvanih po svojoj izuzetnoj geološkoj vrednosti. U centru Francuske, zapadno od Klermon Ferana, nalazi se više od 80 vulkana sa neverovatnim i raznovrsnim oblicima, na pojasu dužine 40 i širine 3 kilometra. Poput reklame za mineralnu vodu, ovaj predeo odiše spokojem. Zapravo, na mnogim sličnim mestima, čovečanstvo je često imalo koristi od boravka u blizini vulkana. Ali rizik je uvek da do erupcije može doći u bilo kom trenutku bez upozorenja.

programme.title: Život ispod nule
programme.desc: Stanovnici Aljaske suočavaju se sa poteškoćama. Za Glena i Endija, temperature ispod nule i debeo led otežavaju postavljanje zamki. Padavine komplikuju trku pasa za vuču, u kojoj učestvuje Džesi.

programme.title: Život ispod nule
programme.desc: Stanovnici Aljaske moraju da iskoriste kratke sate dnevne svetlosti kako bi napravili neophodne alatke, održavali svoje zemljište, lovili hranu koja im je potrebna i usavršili veštine preživljavanja.

programme.title: Život ispod nule
programme.desc: Na Arktiku, potraga za vodom, ogrevom i drugim životnim resursima predstavlja stalan izazov. Ona od stanovnika Aljaske zahteva da istražuju udaljene predele nepogodne za uobičajen ljudski život.

programme.title: Život ispod nule
programme.desc: Neuobičajeno slabe snežne padavine i kasno zaleđivanje na Arktiku predstavljaju nove izazove za stanovnike Aljaske. Kretanje opasnim stazama kroz divljinu postaje sve rizičnije.

programme.title: Život ispod nule
programme.desc: Dok zima popušta, stanovnici Aljaske se upuštaju u nove poduhvate i stiču nove veštine neophodne za preživljavanje. Oni grade skloništa, skupljaju ogrevno drvo i prave zalihe hrane.

programme.title: Planinski veterinar
programme.desc: Od tvoraca serije "Jorkširski veterinar" dolazi nam emisija "Veterinar iz Hajlenda" _ dokumentarna serija smeštena u najseverniju britansku ordinaciju na kopnu, u Kejtnesu. Snimljena tokom surovih zima i proleća, serija prati veterinare, medicinske sestre i osoblje dok brinu o domaćim životinjama, kućnim ljubimcima, konjima i divljim životinjama. Pratimo živote životinja i upoznajemo jedan posvećen tim. Nijedan dan za njih nije isti.

programme.title: Planinski veterinar
programme.desc: Od tvoraca serije "Jorkširski veterinar" dolazi nam emisija "Veterinar iz Hajlenda" _ dokumentarna serija smeštena u najseverniju britansku ordinaciju na kopnu, u Kejtnesu. Snimljena tokom surovih zima i proleća, serija prati veterinare, medicinske sestre i osoblje dok brinu o domaćim životinjama, kućnim ljubimcima, konjima i divljim životinjama. Pratimo živote životinja i upoznajemo jedan posvećen tim. Nijedan dan za njih nije isti.

programme.title: Atenboro i morski zmaj
programme.desc: Izuzetno otkriće će otkriti tajne skrivane 200 miliona godina. U trošnoj litici nalazi se fosil ihtiosaurusa _ moćnog okeanskog predatora iz doba dinosaurusa. Budući stariji od dinosaurusa, ovi "riblji gušteri" imali su najbolje osobine gmizavaca i sisara _ mogli su da regulišu telesnu temperaturu, imali su neverovatan vid i koristili su brzinu, organe za otkrivanje plena i oštre zube da bi dominirali morima. Ser Dejvid Atenboro nas vodi kroz ovu naučnu detektivsku priču _ od vađenja fosila do zapanjujuće 3D rekonstrukcije _ kako bismo saznali kako je ovaj neverovatni "morski zmaj" nekada živeo i lovio.

programme.title: Atenborouove čudesne pesme
programme.desc: Ser Dejvid Atenborou bira svoje omiljene snimke iz sveta prirode, koji objašnjavaju poj životinja. Svaki od njih, od pesme najvećeg lemura do pesme grbavog kita, snimljen je za njegovog života. "Postoji sedam snimaka pesama, koji su mi posebno zanimljivi", kaže on. "Neki su divni, neki su iznenađujući, a jedan mi je skoro slomio srce. Ali svi su na neki način posebni". Nauka o pesmi je prethodno bila transformisana teorijom seksualne selekcije Čarlsa Darvina _ pevanje je opasno jer otkriva lokaciju pevača predatorima. Pored toga, mužjaku nudi ogromnu nagradu u vidu šanse da privuče ženku i prenese gene na sledeću generaciju. Ali nova naučna otkrića ukazuju na to da treba još mnogo toga da se nauči o pesmi u svetu prirode.

programme.title: Glavna ajkula: Bitka polova
programme.desc: Milionima godina, velike bele ajkule su vladale okeanima, ali među ovim vrhovnim predatorima, besni još jedna bitka između mužjaka i ženki. Pridružite se dr Rajliju Eliotu i morskom biologu Kori Burkhart kod obale Novog Zelanda, na takmičenju ajkula kakvo niste videli do sada. Po prvi put, oni suprotstavljaju dva pola direktno u nizu eksperimenata, osmišljenih da testiraju njihovu brzinu, snagu i hrabrost. Cilj je da se otkrije koja velika bela suvereno ajkula vlada.

programme.title: Bik ajkula
programme.desc: Smatrane najopasnijim ajkulama na svetu, bik ajkule su savršene mašine za ubijanje. Postoje dva mesta na svetu gde ove smrtonosne ajkule prave najviše haosa, to su SAD i Australija. Američke ajkule su odgovorne za više napada, ali australijske ajkule će vas verovatnije ubiti. Naši domaćini su preživeli napade ajkula. Bivši ronilac mornarice, Pol de Gelder, i morski biolog, Krejg O'Konel, upoređuju ove dve populacije i porede njihovu snagu ugriza, veličinu, brzinu i agresiju, sa ciljem da odgovorimo na pitanje: koje ajkule su najopasnije na svetu?

programme.title: Napad Samurajskih ajkula
programme.desc: Skelet star 3 000 godina, prvobitno pronađen 20. godina u blizini japanskog unutrašnjeg mora Seto, prekriven je neobično dubokim posekotinama. Izgleda kao žrtva besnog napada samurajskim mačem. Ali čovek, nazvan "Cukumo 24", umro je stotinama godina pre nego što su napravljeni prvi japanski mačevi. Sada, međunarodni tim naučnika sa Univerziteta u Kjotu ponovo otvara slučaj sa zapanjujućom teorijom _ da li je ovog čoveka ubila ajkula? Ako jeste, da li bi ovo mogao biti najstariji napad ajkule ikada istražen i koja vrsta je glavni osumnjičeni?

programme.title: Uhvati me ako možeš
programme.desc: Film "Uhvati me ako možeš" inspirisan je istinitom pričom o brilijantnom mladom majstoru prevare i FBI agentu koji mu je stalno na tragu. Trostruki dobitnik oskara Stiven Spilberg snimio je ovu priču o Frenku Ebognejlu Junioru, koji se uspešno izdaje za pilota, advokata i doktora i sve to pre svog 21. rodendana.

programme.title: Barutski milkšejk
programme.desc: Sem je imala samo 12 godina kada je njena majka Skarlet, elitni ubica, bila primorana da je napusti. Odgojila ju je Firma, nemilosrdni zločinački sindikat za koji je radila njena majka. Sada, 15 godina kasnije, Sem je krenula stopama svoje majke i odrasla u žestokog serijskog ubicu. Koristi svoje "talente" za čišćenje najopasnijih nereda Firme. Ona je efikasna koliko i lojalna. Ali kada visoko rizični posao pođe po zlu, Sem mora da bira između služenja firmi i zaštite života nevine osmogodišnje devojčice _ Emili. Sa metom na leđima, Sem ima samo jednu šansu da preživi: Da se ponovo spoji sa majkom i njenim smrtonosnim saradnicama Bibliotekarkama. Ove tri generacije žena sada moraju da nauče da veruju jedna drugoj, suprotstave se Firmi i njihovoj vojsci poslušnika i naprave pakao onima koji bi mogli sve da im oduzmu.

programme.title: Beli pas
programme.desc: Jedne noći mlada glumica Julia Sajer (K. McNichol) autom naleti na belog nemačkog ovčara i teško ga povredi. Nakon što ga veterinar izleči, Julia odvede psa svojoj kući, pokušavajući mu, uz pomoć dečka (J. Parker), pronaći vlasnike. Julia se sve više zbližava sa psom, naročito nakon što ovčar napadne silovatelja koji provali u njenu kuću, zadržavši ga do dolaska policije. Jedne noći pas ipak pobegne i ubije tamnoputog vozača kamiona. Po povratku, pas napadne na snimanju glumičinu tamnoputu koleginicu i Julia odluči odvesti psa kod dresera. Tamo sazna da je pas dresiran...

programme.title: Svaki put kad umrem
programme.desc: Kada Sem bude ubijen u udaljenom jezeru, njegova svest počinje da putuje kroz tela njegovih prijatelja u nastojanju da ih zaštiti od ubice. Ovaj mračni prolaz vodi ga na veće putovanje _ otkrivanje sopstvenog pravog identiteta.

programme.title: Brzi Čarli
programme.desc: Charlie Swift već dvadeset godina radi kao plaćeni ubica za mafijaša Stana. Nakon što suparnička mafija ubije Stana i njegovu ekipu, Charlie, kao jedini preživeli, odluči osvetiti svog prijatelja, pa se udruži s Marcie, bivšom suprugom mafijaša kojeg je ubio...

programme.title: Ne brini draga
programme.desc: Alis i Džek imaju sreće što žive u idealizovanoj zajednici Viktorija, eksperimentalnom kompanijskom gradu u kom žive muškarci koji rade za tajni projekat "Viktorija" i njihove porodice. Društveni optimizam iz 1950-ih koji je zastupao njihov izvršni direktor Frenk _ korporativni vizionarski i motivacioni životni trener _ usidrio se u svaki aspekt svakodnevnog života u tesno povezanoj pustinjskoj utopiji. Dok muževi provode svaki dan u sedištu projekta "Viktorija", radeći na "razvoju progresivnih materijala", njihove žene _ uključujući Frenkovu elegantnu partnerku Šeli _ provode vreme uživajući u lepoti, luksuzu i razvratu svoje zajednice. Život je savršen, a potrebe svakog stanara ispunjava kompanija. Sve što traže zauzvrat je diskrecija i neupitna posvećenost cilju pobede. Ali kada počnu da se pojavljuju pukotine u njihovom idiličnom životu, otkrivajući bljeskove nečeg mnogo zlokobnijeg što vreba ispod atraktivne fasade, Alis ne može da ne dovede u pitanje šta tačno rade u "Viktoriji" i zašto.

programme.title: Harli Dejvidson i Marlboro Čovek
programme.desc: Harli i Marlboro su prijatelji koji se znaju oduvek, a omiljeno okupljalište im je bar poput onoga kod koga su odrasli. Bar je pred bankrotom i naši momci odluče da opljačkaju oklopno vozilo kako bi nabavili malo keša. Ali, velika greška, vozilo prevozi najnoviju drogu i ista pripada gadnim vlasnicima koji su spremni napraviti sve šta mogu da je vrate nazad, pa i poubijati sve šta hoda ili vozi opake motore. Saterani u ćošak, naši junaci, u pravom vestern maniru, odluče da uzvrate udarac.

programme.title: Zatvoreno ostrvo
programme.desc: Dvojica američkih šerifa, Tedi Danijels i Čak Ojl, odlaze 1954. u bolnicu Ešklif na jednom izolovanom ostrvu blizu Masačusetsa sa zadatkom da istraže slučaj Rejčel Solando, pacijentkinje koja je nestala iz zatvorene sobe. Psihijatar, dr Džon Koli, šef odseka, objašnjava da je nestala pacijentkinja hospitalizovana nakon nervnog sloma koji je doživela kada joj se utopilo troje dece. Istražitelji nailaze na mnoge poteškoće, a Danijelsu jedne noći njegova bivša žena, koja je poginula u požaru, u snu saopštava da je Rejčel još živa. Kasnije istražitelji dolaze do otkrića da se u Ešklifu vrše interesantni eksperimenti, što sve zajedno pogubno deluje na Danijelsovu psihu…

programme.title: Zatvoreno ostrvo
programme.desc: Dvojica američkih šerifa, Tedi Danijels i Čak Ojl, odlaze 1954. u bolnicu Ešklif na jednom izolovanom ostrvu blizu Masačusetsa sa zadatkom da istraže slučaj Rejčel Solando, pacijentkinje koja je nestala iz zatvorene sobe. Psihijatar, dr Džon Koli, šef odseka, objašnjava da je nestala pacijentkinja hospitalizovana nakon nervnog sloma koji je doživela kada joj se utopilo troje dece. Istražitelji nailaze na mnoge poteškoće, a Danijelsu jedne noći njegova bivša žena, koja je poginula u požaru, u snu saopštava da je Rejčel još živa. Kasnije istražitelji dolaze do otkrića da se u Ešklifu vrše interesantni eksperimenti, što sve zajedno pogubno deluje na Danijelsovu psihu…

programme.title: Otrovna ruža
programme.desc: Bivša sportska zvezda radi kao privatni detektiv u Holivudu i okoreli je kockar i alkoholičar. Dobija novi slučaj koji ga odvodi u rodni grad Galveston u Teksasu, u potrazi za nestalom ženom. Tokom istrage moraće da se suoči ne samo sa samim vrhom organizovanog kriminala i bivšom ljubavnicom, veći i sa svojom mračnom prošlošću.

programme.title: Crna poternica
programme.desc: Polupenzionisani specijalni ubica i agent DEA ukrštaju se u odvojenim misijama, kako bi zaustavili sajber terorističku organizaciju koja je izgradila opasnu mašinu koja preti da će napasti električnu mrežu i doneti katastrofu svetu...

programme.title: Tvin Piks Vatra ide samnom
programme.desc: Film u početku prati istragu agenta FBI-a o ubistvu portira u smeni konobarice Tereze u malom mestu u Vašingtonu. Kada agent pronalazi misteriozan trag o ubistvu, on neobjašnjivo nestaje. Radnja filma se zatim nastavlja godinu dana kasnije i prati poslednje nedelje života problematične tinejdžerke Lore Palmer, njenu zaovisnost o drogama, težak odnos sa šizofreničnim ocem i dva karakterno različita dečka.

programme.title: Zemlja bande
programme.desc: Kada očajni porodični čovek Šelbi uz pomoć svog nepromišljenog šuraka Treja opljačka mesto na kome se nezakonito proizvode tablete, taj naizgled lak posao dovede do nasilja. Mafija iz NJu Orleansa saznaje šta se dogodilo i surovi uterivač počne da preti Šelbijevoj porodici...

programme.title: Harli Dejvidson i Marlboro Čovek
programme.desc: Harli i Marlboro su prijatelji koji se znaju oduvek, a omiljeno okupljalište im je bar poput onoga kod koga su odrasli. Bar je pred bankrotom i naši momci odluče da opljačkaju oklopno vozilo kako bi nabavili malo keša. Ali, velika greška, vozilo prevozi najnoviju drogu i ista pripada gadnim vlasnicima koji su spremni napraviti sve šta mogu da je vrate nazad, pa i poubijati sve šta hoda ili vozi opake motore. Saterani u ćošak, naši junaci, u pravom vestern maniru, odluče da uzvrate udarac.

programme.title: Beli prah
programme.desc: Odrastajući u porodici sitnog preduzetnika koja je često jedva spajala kraj s krajem, Džordž Jung je još kao dečak sam sebi obećao da, kad odraste neće deliti sličnu sudbinu. Tako je, nakon preseljenja u Kaliforniju, počeo da se bavi nezakonitim poslovima. U zatvoru je završio zbog dilovanja droge. Tamo upoznaje svog budućeg partnera koji ga upozorava na velike mogućnosti zarade u švercovanju kokaina, droge koja još nije bila zavladala tržištem narkotika. Po izlasku iz zatvora, Jung postaje jedna od ključnih osoba za uvoz kokaina u Ameriku, tvrdeći kako kontroliše čak 85% tržišta. Međutim, ni sav novac ni luksuz koji je stekao nisu mogli da ga pripreme za opasnosti biznisa u koji se upleo.

programme.title: Riplijeva igra
programme.desc: Za javnost je rafinirani ljubitelj umetnosti koji živi s pijanistkinjom Luizom Harari, u prekrasnoj istorijskoj palati u Italijanskoj pokrajini Veneto. Pravo lice mu je drugačije. On preprodaje skupe falsifikate klasičnih umetničkih dela koje mu nabavlja britanski gangster Rivs. Rivs traži plaćenog ubicu, a Ripli mu predlaže Trevanija, biznismena koji umire od raka i kojem je novac potreban.

programme.title: Očuh
programme.desc: Majkl Harding se vraća kući iz vojne škole i saznaje da je njegova majka srećno zaljubljena u Davida sa kojim je počela i da živi. Dok se dvojica muškaraca upoznaju, Majkl postaje sve više i više sumnjičav u vezi čoveka koji je uvek tu da pomogne. Da li je on zaista muškarac njenih snova ili možda David krije svoju mračnu stranu?

programme.title: Izgubljeni momci 3: Žeđ
programme.desc: Spavanje celi dan. Zabava celu noć. Niko ne stari i ne umire. Biti vampir je zabavno ukoliko niste žrtva ili vampir koji se našao u blizini Edgara ili Alana Froga. Muzika praši. Krv šiklja. A demoni i braća Frog vrebaju u noći!

programme.title: Tajno
programme.desc: Film je zasnovan na skandaloznom romanu Emila Zole "Tereza Raken" i to je priča o opsesivnoj ljubavi koja prerasta u zločin i osvetu na periferiji Pariza 1860-ih godina. Tereza je očaravajuća, ali seksualno represivna mlada žena koja je zarobljena u braku bez ljubavi sa bolešljivim rođakom Kamilom, zahvaljujući svojoj dominantnoj tetki madam Raken. Tereza mora da provodi dane kao zatvorenica iza pulta male prodavnice, a večeri joj prolaze tako što gleda madam kako igra domine. Ali kad upozna Lorenta, muževljevog očaravajućeg prijatelja iz detinjstva, sve se menja. Ono što počinje kao uzbudljiva, zabranjena i tajna afera ubrzo prerasta u šokantan niz tragičnih događaja.

programme.title: Tim
programme.desc: Inženjerka protetike, Abi, seli se na selo kako bi radila na najnovijem proizvodu kompanije Integrate Robotic _ humanoidnoj veštačkoj inteligenciji zvanoj T.I.M.

programme.title: Kum
programme.desc: Saga o mafijaškoj porodici Korleone. Priča počinje na venčanju ćerke Don Vita Korleonea. Dolazi i njegov sin Majkl koji ne želi da učestvuje u porodičnom "poslu". Ali, sticaj okolnosti ubacuje ga u te vode, jer Vito ne može sam da izađe na kraj s problemima koji ga pritiskaju.

programme.title: Po cenu života
programme.desc: Kada banka zapreti da će zbog hipoteke preuzeti porodično imanje, braća Tobi i Taner Havard iz Teksasa odluče krenuti u osvetu pljačkajući sve poslovnice banke koja je njihovoj porodici ugrozila budućnost. Iskusni šerif im ulazi u trag i odlučan ih je zaustaviti iako nailazi na otpor meštana koji podržavaju braću u njihovom isterivanju pravde.

programme.title: Lovci na drago kamenje
programme.desc: Spremite se za ludu vožnju sa tragačima za safirom u centralnom Kvinslendu. Želja za pronalaskom ovog vrednog kamena motiviše rudare da ispitaju svoje granice.

programme.title: Vikinzi na ledu
programme.desc: Upoznajte se sa načinom života i izazovima lovaca na ledu sa jezera Vinipeg. Budući da su oni potomci Vikinga sa Islanda, služe se tradicionalnim metodama lova na ledukoje su naučili od predaka.

programme.desc: U seriji Australijski lovci na zlaro, pratimo tri okorela tima lovaca na zlato dok stavljaju sve na kocku i bore se da pronađu veliko nalazište, duboko na divljem zapadu u divljini Australije.

programme.title: Lov u Smrtonosnom rtu
programme.desc: Porodica Dejvi živi na jednom od najudaljenijih i najspektakularnijih mesta na Zemlji. Njeni članovi izdržljivo podnose neke od najopasnijih i najnepredvidivih vremenskih uslova i svakodnevno se bore sa smrtonosnim ajkulama, krokodilima, opasnim meduzama, ali i rivalskim skiperima, koji jure veoma cenjenu i neuhvatljivu špansku skušu. Ova porodica i njenih nekoliko generacija zarađuje za život na jedan od najopasnijih načina _ pecanjem ručnom udicom u opasnim vodama u Australiji. Potrebna im je velika telesna snaga da iz mora izvuku ove svirepe ribe, teške po 30 kilograma.

programme.title: Građenje divova
programme.desc: Ova serija prikazuje muškarce i žene koji su učestvovali u građenju osam najimpozantnijih građevina u svetu. Ona istražuje inženjerske inovacije, koje će zauvek promeniti standarde graditeljstva.

programme.desc: Mehaničar Šeldon Nikols i stručnjak za karoseriju Piter Hariot su dugogodišnji prijatelji. Zajedno traže i popravljaju klasične automobile za svoje klijente i trude se da u tom procesu nešto i zarade.

programme.desc: Kris i Nika se sukobljavaju dok prelaze na novi iskopani prostor. Kam se bori sa kvarovima mašina i kontaminiranim gorivom. Kenovi i Gijomovi planovi skoro propadaju.

programme.title: Nacisti, podmornice i bitka za Atlantik
programme.desc: Najduža kampanja Drugog svetskog rata odvijala se u Atlantskom okeanu. Hitlerove flote podmornica vrebale su u čoporima, progoneći savezničke konvoje koji su dopremali ključne zalihe u Veliku Britaniju. Čerčil je zapisao da je njegov najveći strah tokom čitavog rata bila pretnja od podmornica. Luka Deri imala je ključnu ulogu kao najzapadnija baza Ujedinjenog Kraljevstva. Upravo ovde su nemačke podmornice na kraju rata dovedene radi zvanične predaje, pre nego što su potopljene nadomak severozapadne obale Irske. Specijalizovani tim ronilaca u dubokim vodama traga za ovim olupinama, dok istoričari rasvetljavaju dramatične sukobe i ljudske žrtve.

programme.title: Vikinzi: stvaranje carstva
programme.desc: Nakon što je oterao svog oca sa prestola Danske, Sven Forkbeard nastavlja sa tradicionalnim vikinškim aktivnostima koje je njegov otac neko vreme napustio, a to su krvavi napadi na Englesku.

programme.title: Vikinzi: stvaranje carstva
programme.desc: Sven iznenada umire manje od pet nedelja nakon što je preuzeo engleski tron. Njegov sin Knut Veliki veruje da može da nasledi svog oca na mestu kralja, ali engleski narod odlučuje drugačije.

programme.title: Skrivene tajne Jadrana
programme.desc: Ova dokumentarna serija istražuje istoriju takozvanog Jadranskog basena. Biće reči o najnovijim otkrićima, koja nesumnjivo ukazuju na to da su drevni ljudi naseljavali ovo područje 30 000 godina pre Hrista. Uz pomoć istoričara i entuzijastičnih istraživača, uranjamo u prošlost regiona gde su mnogi kraljevi i carevi vladali i vodili ratove. Ovo je bilo vreme u kome su bezbrojne vojne sile naišle na sebi ravne, vladale su mudre vođe, vešti graditelji gradili, a tehnološki napredne civilizacije gledale u zvezde. Ovo je period koji jse smatra jednom od kolevki zapadne civilizacije.

Biće reči o najnovijim otkrićima, koja nesumnjivo ukazuju na to da su drevni ljudi naseljavali ovo područje 30 000 godina pre Hrista. Uz pomoć istoričara i entuzijastičnih istraživača, uranjamo u prošlost regiona gde su mnogi kraljevi i carevi vladali i vodili ratove. Ovo je bilo vreme u kome su bezbrojne vojne sile naišle na sebi ravne, vladale su mudre vođe, vešti graditelji gradili, a tehnološki napredne civilizacije gledale u zvezde. Ovo je period koji jse smatra jednom od kolevki zapadne civilizacije.

programme.desc: Hitlerovo zdravlje se pogoršavalo. Gering je jedva bio pri zdravoj pameti zbog zavisnosti od morfijuma. Kako se rat menjao, Hitler i njegova svita su se povukli u bunker i inscenirali njegov kraj.

programme.title: Drevna Pompeja - Tajne vile Oplontis
programme.desc: U prvom veku nove ere, Napuljski zaliv bio je stecište bogataša. Jedna vila se posebno isticala luksuzom i razmerama. Nova otkrića u vili Oplontis pružaju uvid u živote bogatih i potlačenih.

programme.title: Drevna Pompeja - Tajne vile Oplontis
programme.desc: U prvom veku nove ere, Napuljski zaliv bio je stecište bogataša. Jedna vila se posebno isticala luksuzom i razmerama. Nova otkrića u vili Oplontis pružaju uvid u živote bogatih i potlačenih.

programme.title: Enigma mumije iz močvare
programme.desc: Ovo je dragocena arheološka relikvija, izuzetan nalaz sačuvan u danskoj močvari, tokom više od 2.500 godina. Tolundski čovek je prirodna mumija koja nudi redak susret licem u lice sa prošlošću. Kada razmišljamo o ovom usnulom licu koje je nekim čudom preživelo vekove, padaju nam na pamet mnoga pitanja _ odakle je, ko je bio, kako je živeo i šta je radio ovde u tresetu ,sa užetom oko vrata?

programme.title: Najsmrtonosniji lov na veštice
programme.desc: Godine 1609, u Baskiji, jedan lokalni spor prerastao je u optužbe za veštičarenje. Anri IV, kralj Francuske, odlučio je da uspostavi red na granicama kraljevstva. Poslao je komisiju da sudi vešticama i čarobnjacima. Suđenje je trajalo četiri meseca. Pjer de Lankr, sudija parlamenta u Bordou, uhapsio je i 80 ljudi osudio na smrt i oni su spaljeni na lomači. Između 15. i 17. veka, između 40 000 i 60 000 ljudi osuđeno je zbog veštičarenja. Bio je to ciklus nasilja bez presedana, čijih su 80% žrtava činile žene. Danas istoričari istražuju šta se zapravo dogodilo.

programme.title: Traganje za blagom sa Betani Hjuz
programme.desc: Profesorka Betani Hjuz putuje po svetu i istražuje istoriju čovečanstva. Usput dolazi do novih otkrića i pruža više informacija o neverovatnim bogatstvima ljudske civilizacije.

programme.title: Faraoni: figure veće od piramida
programme.desc: Kleopatra VII, poslednja kraljica drevnog Egipta, sinonim je za pad Egipta pod Rim. Ova epizoda razotkriva istinu koja se krije iza njene smrti, koja je među istoričarima bila predmet mnogih debata.

programme.title: Hitlerove igre u boji - Berlin 1936.
programme.desc: Tokom dve nedelje u avgustu 1936. godine, u Berlinu, kamere su zabeležile najveći svetski sportski spektakl, uključujući i trijumfe rekordnog sprintera Džesija Ovensa, koji je osvojio zlatnu medalju. Berlinske Olimpijske igre bile su prekretnica _ mnoge inovacije uvedene 1936. godine, poput televizijskog prenosa i štafete sa bakljom, postale su deo svakih narednih Igara. Ovaj dokumentarac priča o izvanrednim amaterima koji su se istakli, ali i o tome kako je Hitler koristio Igre kao propagandu za svoj brutalni režim. Koristeći crno-belu arhivu, transformisanu najsavremenijom restauracijom i kolorizacijom, ovo je priča o 16 dana koji su osvojili svet _ i zaveli ga.

programme.title: Faraoni u ratu
programme.desc: Kleopatra osvaja egipatski presto savezništvom sa moćnicima da povrati vlast. Suočavajući se sa Oktavijanom u bici kod Akcijuma, ništa ne ide po planu i dovodi do njenog pada i njegovog uspona.

programme.title: Bombarder - strah i trepet Drugog svetskog rata
programme.desc: Postoji katalog izuma u istoriji ratovanja, sa pronalascima koji su uneli promene u način ratovanja. Jedna vrsta oružja promenila je, ne samo bojno polje, već i rat, sam po sebi _ to je bombarder.

programme.title: Izgubljeni gradovi Džingis Kana
programme.desc: Od Mongolije pa sve do Turske, otkrivena su četiri izgubljena grada koja datiraju još iz srednjeg veka. Istoričari i arheolozi otkrivaju kako su Džingis-kan, osnivač Mongolskog carstva, i njegovi potomci uspevali da održe red i mir u najvećem kontinentalnom carstvu u istoriji. Daleko od klišea koji se pripisuju varvarskim ratnicima, nomadi Mongoli bili se dobri političari i, što je iznenađujuće, veliki graditelji naselja u kojima je cvetalo mirno multikulturalno društvo.

programme.desc: Činilo se da je Severna Amerika bezbedna od užasa rata tokom većeg dela II sv. rata, ali jezivo otkriće u udaljenim krajevima istočne Kanade nagoveštava dubine nacističkih pomorskih sposobnosti.

programme.desc: Otkrivamo kako su ekonomska previranja, povređeni nacionalni ponos i "harizmatična" ličnost doveli do neviđene brutalnosti tokom II sv. rata, a nju su oblikovali muškarci i žene bliski Hitleru.

programme.title: Nacisti - niti zla
programme.desc: Vilhelm Kajtel, Hitlerov najviši vojni poslušnik, potpisao je naređenja koja su pokrenula ratne zločine i masovna ubistva širom Evrope. Slepo poslušan do kraja, nodgovarao je pred sudom u Nirnbergu.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler - razotkrivanje diktatora
programme.desc: Da li je Adolf Hitler bio majstor ili tvorac rata? Njegova težnja za teritorijalnom dominacijom dovela je do ranih trijumfa, ali odbijanje da sluša svoje generale dovelo je do katastrofalnih neuspeha.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler - razotkrivanje diktatora
programme.desc: Uvidom u njegovo teško detinjstvo u Austriji i vrtoglavi uspeh kao Firera u nacističkoj Nemačkoj, shvatićemo da je život Adolfa Hitlera imao uticaj na stvaranje njegove poremećene ličnosti.

programme.title: Adolf Hitler - razotkrivanje diktatora
programme.desc: Ova serija istražuje šest karakterističnih aspekata života i vladavine Adolfa Hitlera i ispituje kako je tridesetogodišnji i neobrazovani čovek uspeo da ostavi u nasleđe zlo bez presedana.

programme.title: Abu Simbel: giganti sa Nila
programme.desc: Pre više od 3 000 godina, Ramzes II započeo je građenje dva kolosalna hrama, posvećena faraonu i njegovoj ženi Nefertari. Radnici su iskopali 55 metara u dubnu brda koje ima pogled na Nil i napravili gigantske odaje, sa stubovima od preko 10 metara. Statue faraona koji sedi na tronu visoke su po 20 metara, a fasade ova dva hrama oslikavale su sve norme tog perioda. Kako je ovakav poduhvat uopšte bio moguć i kako su Egipćani uspeli da organizuju i vode ovakav projekat, koji je od delte Nila udaljen 1 500 kilometara?Arhitekte, arheolozi i inženjeri pronašli su odgovore na ova pitanja u jednom drugom kolosalnom izazovu _ rasklapanju ove strukture kako bi je zaštitili od nadolazećih voda reke Nil.

programme.title: Faraoni u ratu
programme.desc: Nakon Hatšepsutine smrti, Tutmes III se dokazao kod Megida protiv hananskih kraljeva; od Deir el-Baharija do Karnaka i tvrđave, otkrijte bitku koja ga je učinila najratobornijim faraonom Egipta.

programme.title: Faraoni u ratu
programme.desc: 1274. p. n. e. Egipatski faraon Ramzes II i hetitski kralj Muvatali II sukobljavaju se u jednoj od najvećih bitaka antike kod Kadeša u priči o špijunima, iznenađenjima i preokretima sreće.

programme.title: Kleopatra - rešavanje enigme
programme.desc: Ova serija istražuje sve što znamo o Kleopatri. Pratimo stručnjake u njihovim najnovijim istraživanjima, koja kulminiraju otkrićem jednog od njenih blaga, potopljenog pod morem.

programme.title: Kleopatra - rešavanje enigme
programme.desc: Ova serija istražuje sve što znamo o Kleopatri. Pratimo stručnjake u njihovim najnovijim istraživanjima, koja kulminiraju otkrićem jednog od njenih blaga, potopljenog pod morem.

programme.title: Nirnberški proces - suđenje veka
programme.desc: Novembar 1945. U Nirnbergu, 21 visoki nacistički zvaničnik sedi na optuženičkoj klupi tokom istorijskog suđenja. Skoro 300 ličnosti iz sveta novinarstva i književnosti dolazi da prati taj proces.

programme.title: Nirnberški proces - suđenje veka
programme.desc: Do proleća 1946. godine raste zabrinutost _ suđenje biva ugroženo početkom Hladnog rata, koji dovodi u pitanje jedinstvo između zapadnih i sovjetskih sudija. Hoće li suđenje biti privedeno kraju?

programme.title: Šta su pronašli
programme.desc: U režiji Sema Mendesa, ovaj dokumentarac govori o dva vojnika snimatelja _ narednicima Majku Luisu i Bilu Loriju _ iz Filmske i fotografske jedinice britanske vojske (AFPU) koji su poslati na evropski front tokom druge polovine Drugog svetskog rata. U aprilu 1945. godine, njih dvojica su naišla na ono što im je rečeno da je bolnica za tifus oko 25 kilometara od malog grada po imenu Cele u severnoj Nemačkoj _ poznatog pod imenom Bergen-Belzen. Pravi užasi onoga što se dešavalo u logoru su im otkriveni _ a kroz njihov snimak svetu _ po prvi put; kombinujući snimak koji su ovi ljudi snimili u Bergen-Belzenu sa njihovim audio intervjuom (koji su snimili Imperijalni ratni muzeji 1980-ih), ovaj dokumentarac postaje lični zapis o odlučujućem iskustvu dva obična muškarca tokom rata i, kroz njih, deo duboke traume i tragedije Holokausta.

programme.desc: The Obersalzberg was an ordinary Bavarian mountain until Adolf Hitler discovered it in 1923. There at the Berghof, the Nazi leader spent his time surrounded by his most faithful lieutenants and his mistress, Eva Braun. Though mostly destroyed, remnants of the vast building complex still exist.

programme.desc: America's military history is on display on the decks of the USS North Carolina. Then we visit the historic Confederate Fort Fisher civil war museum and learn about the Carolina's role in the civil war.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: The live music capital of the US has an interesting past. Take an in depth look at one of Austin's oldest hotels, The Driskill. Then we'll learn about Texan independence in the Bob Bullock History museum. Finally, we'll end up at one of Austin's most historic buildings, the Texas state capitol.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Snow is a fascinating world of crystals that animals, plants, and humans have had to adapt to, in order to benefit from its best and survive its worst attributes. Some communities live with Tornadoes by building homes with survival features and rather than get out of their paths, they rely on warning systems and classifications. And behind all great weather events is Wind, find out how and why it can change from a gentle breeze into a devastating gale force and where does it go? Nature's force can be mystical and puzzling and the Sunshower has been the subject of myths and legends and superstitions, but it does have a scientific explanation.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: What is La Nina and how is it being monitored? Find out the effects and the reach that this system is influencing. How did Indian Summer get its name and what is the science behind the phenomenon? Winter is the season that has the biggest effect on the planet, animal behaviour and often brings out the worst that nature can bring. Nature's Halo is a magical sight with a scientific explanation. The story of and lessons from Hurricane Katrina give us a great understanding of the ferocity and speed that nature can unleash

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: In the spirit of coastal conservation, Big Coast practices catch-and-release Tyee Chinook Salmon (over 30lbs) angling and only taking what you need. Going strong for 15 years, Big Coast features 13 new half hour episodes every year! A 300-mile boat trip from Vancouver to Duncanby Lodge in Rivers Inlet for Percy Walkus Hatchery Chinook Fundraiser!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: In this episode, Ray explores the Red Centre of the country and shows that the Australian desert is filled with life for those who know where to find water.He arrives in the Red Centre by chopper as he flies over the Uluru monolith or Ayres Rock. For his first stop, he goes to a red kangaroo sanctuary where he cuddles a joey, meets their carer Brolga and gets close to the usually wary adult red kangaroos. He pursues his journey deeper in the desert to meet a local aboriginal Sammy Wilson. They go to a traditional waterhole and chat over a camp fire about Sammy's ancestral knowledge of the land. Ray spends the night out under the stars before driving more inland to rocky areas where water collects. There Ray comes face to face with a wild kangaroo and rock wallabies. He then follows tracks along a dry river bed that lead him to Australia's wild dog: a dingo.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: With classic tales as The Jungle Book to his credit, Rudyard Kipling brought India to life for many readers around the world. In this episode, Bill steps back into Kipling's wild world while exploring Kanha and Bandhavgarh National Parks, the inspiration for The Jungle Book and many other tales. There, we track tigers and search for jackal, sambar, chital, monkeys and wild boar. We round out the episode with jeep safaris, elephant rides and dinners around the fire.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Journeys explores the history and fables that surround the controversial rebel leader Tipu Sultan. Mysore was the center of an Empire strong enough to challenge the British. Tipu's over-the-top personality is reflected in the architecture, gardens and stories that still permeate this metropolis.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: The name alone conjures up mysterious and exotic images. The architecture and backstory to this once powerful independent kingdom, is both amazing and horrifying. Outside the city, Zanzibar earns its "Spice Island" nickname due to the huge plantations that grow everything to make your cooking flavorful. Journeys final stop is to visit the highly endangered Red Colobus monkeys. Learn why these human-like primates eat dirt for survival.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: In this first of a two-parter on the Mara, we follow the migration in anticipation of the famous river crossings. We find all three big cats and hyena waiting for their chance to get their share of the migrants. During migration, the animal numbers are staggering.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Three paragliders explore the flight opportunities in Tenerife, a volcanic region of Mt. Teide, in the Canary Islands.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: A magnificent journey of cultural enrichment and hair raising heli-skiing in Beautiful British Columbia.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim

programme.title: Of Boats And Men
programme.desc: Travelling by boat bears a priceless sense of Freedom and offers endless new vistas to all passengers. Across waterways around the world Boats are an essential tool of daily life whether they carry goods, serve as utilities or services in remote areas.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: They're beautiful _ and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They're lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they're wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic _ all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution. In the Florida Keys, some practical and novel approaches are making progress in the fight against these Toxic Invaders.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: Deep in the heart of Mexico's Yucatan, Jonathan is exploring remote cenotes in the jungle that were once used for Mayan rituals. Just reaching the surface of the water requires rappelling down from the forest above. But then, beneath the surface, he encounters strange alien life forms that live in total darkness, and the remains of humans and animal sacrifices from an ancient culture.

programme.title: Blue World
programme.desc: In the Flower Garden Banks National Marine Sanctuary, Jonathan investigates some of the densest coral reefs in the Caribbean as they spawn under cover of darkness. Then he heads over to Silver Springs for the Sea Hunt Forever Festival, celebrating the classic TV show Sea Hunt and the vintage scuba gear that was used on the program.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: Dali the emperor tamarin is mysteriously going bald—on his back! Keepers suspect two mischievous monkey roommates. Meanwhile, Kristina attempts an eye ultrasound on dolphin Ulysses, needing patience and precision. And it's party time for Garoe the chimp, who celebrates his first birthday with a swinging cake surprise!

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Fanged Spiders with their scurrying bites. The Scorpion with its deadly sting... A sinister cold bloodied crocodile. The hypnotizing venomous snake. Or the King of Beasts, the Lion? Which one is the most dangerous? Lion _ With golden fur and regal mane, the lion reigns as the 'King of Beasts'. Scorpions _ In scorched deserts, danger awakens after sunset. Spiders _ Masters of webs and venom, spiders haunt myth and imagination. Snakes _ Feared and revered, snakes symbolize power, death, and rebirth. Crocodile _ Ancient and deadly, crocodiles inspire fear and legend across the globe.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The legendary wild dingo, the iconic kangaroos, vicious feral cats, the delightfully bizarre platypus and the unmistakably cuddly koala _ all call Australia home. Koala _ Hidden high in gum trees, the koala is one of Australia's most beloved animals. Dingo _ Sleek, agile, and descended from wolves, dingoes are Australia's top land carnivores. Kangaroo _ With powerful legs and iconic bounds, kangaroos embody the spirit of Australia. Wild Cats _ Over 12 million wild house cats roam Australia's diverse landscapes. Platypus _ Unique and mysterious, the platypus is one of Australia's most enchanting creatures.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Predator vs. prey: this episode explores three bird escape tactics—climbing flight, horizontal speed, and diving. These behaviors reflect the evolutionary arms race. Birds of prey captivate us, from the mighty eagle soaring over open spaces to the peregrine falcon, the fastest animal alive. Vultures, often seen as omens, strip carcasses clean to survive. Whether elegant hunters or grim scavengers, each raptor plays its part in the Race of Life, adapting to stay one step ahead.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Crocodiles, descended from reptiles 250 million years ago, lurk just beneath the waterline, striking fear into prey. Turtles, among the oldest reptiles, use their shells for protection and camouflage across land, freshwater, and sea. Snakes, from rattlesnakes to dwarf pipe snakes, share traits like legless bodies and lidless eyes, relying on sun for warmth. The king cobra's venom can kill an elephant. Lizards escape predators by shedding tails, which regrow differently. For reptiles, cold blood offers a survival edge in the Race of Life.

programme.title: Africa's Deadliest
programme.desc: Hippos are terrifying animals in their own right, but they also have enough meat on them to be tempting prey. A pride of 16 lions surround one, but its jaws can crush a skull with one bite _ who will triumph?

programme.title: Creative Killers
programme.desc: On East Africa's plains, millions of wildebeest and zebras migrate, crossing the Mara and Grumeti rivers where crocodiles lie in wait. DC, a dominant croc, faces challenges at each hunting zone—from shallow waters to rocky crossings. He battles rivals, adapts his strategy, and learns to thrive in changing conditions. As the rivers dry and herds thin, DC makes one final kill. The Mara and Grumeti demand unique skills, turning quiet waters into deadly Predator Zones.

programme.title: Speed Kills
programme.desc: Desert creatures endure searing heat and zero rainfall, but speed is their ticket to survival.A Tiger beetle runs at the human equivalent of 500 miles per hour. A caracal jumps six feet to swat a weaverbird out of midair. And the world's fastest chameleon hunts on the desert floor.Only the hardiest, fastest animals survive. Nothing else stands a chance.

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: Around the globe, thousands of decommissioned naval vessels rot in dockyards. What can you do with these toxic time bombs? One solution is to clean them well, blow them up and sink them! Providing shelter and breeding grounds, countless fish and invertebrates colonize steel hulls. In the Cayman Islands, the USS Kittiwake met a watery grave and quickly transformed into a vibrant artificial reef. In the Florida Keys, dozens of purposely sunk ships are a beacon to marine life, and to scuba divers. It seems like a win-win-win situation _ for the environment, for divers and for cash strapped governments. But supporters face tough opposition on many fronts. After years of struggle, Canada's newest artificial reef project _ the HMCS Annapolis, is nearing completion. But will protesters get their way and scuttle the sinking?

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As head of the aquarium, Ester sets a pace that's hard to keep up with _ especially on her Segway! And with a normal day including alligators, zebra sharks, jellyfish and shark pods _ you may need a Segway to keep up with this Spanish dynamo too! When Loro Parque and their volunteers conduct one of their famous beach clean ups _ you won't believe what they unearth! Even better though, a turtle rescued last year with a fishing hook in its throat is being released back to its ocean home. Now that's a good day at the beach.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: Their bodies have long turned to dust, but the spirits of the original owners who built Bellewood remain in charge and don't mind chasing out tresspassers.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The team explores St. Albans, a former sanitarium, and captures several shocking EVPs (spirit voices), including the one that became the title of this episode.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: We'll find out why they called Minneapolis the "Mill City" when we visit the Mill City Museum. Then we march over to the Union's Fort Snelling, the first permanent structure in Minnesota, and then head underground and learn about St. Paul's organized crime hide outs.

programme.title: Travel Thru History
programme.desc: San Antonio is rich with Texas, Mexican, and Spanish history. We make our last stand at the Alamo, and visit Missions National Historical Park. Lastly, we spelunk the Natural Bridge Caverns underground.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Weather is universal and it's also Extra Terrestrial. Learn about space weather and how it can impact us on earth. Supercells are unique storms that scientists have learnt to measure into three types. Under the earth's crust, nature is extremely energetic, and we see this through the Volcano which acts as our eye into the forces beneath our feet. Learn about the purple buzzing glow called St Elmo's Fire, how it was named and were to look for it.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: The beauty, magic, and the science behind the Auroras at both ends of the earth, show them to be more than just a protective magnetic layer. The technology used to measure Wind Speed is finely calibrated with an interesting formula. The Tides remind us of our connection to the moon and our place in the solar system and are monitored for any significant change can have implications for industry, communities, and our ocean life. Earthquakes often make news headlines so how are they measured and predicted and what can we learn from them about our planet? Acid Rain is a manufactured weather event, the result of manmade industry mixing with nature to result in international treaties to lessen emissions and pollution.

programme.title: Big Coast
programme.desc: Fishing Prince Rupert, Ha-Nee-Nah Lodge on Dundas Island and Hecate Strait for Chinook Salmon and Pacific Halibut!

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray Mears explores the Great Barrier Reef starting on the Queensland mainland taking a boat out to Hervey Bay with whale expert Wally Franklin. They witness a mother hump back whale teaching her three month old calf the whale moves needed to survive the long migration to Antarctica.He flies out to Lady Elliot Island at the southernmost tip of the Great Barrier Reef where he goes scuba diving on the coral reef and discovers giant turtles and manta rays and shoals of big eyed trevelly fish.Back on the island Ray helps marine biologist Maggie O'Neal plant a Pisonia tree and finds out how the Pisonia trees kill the Black Noddy bird's that nest in them in order to use their corpses as a fertile compost given the unforgiving ground of a coral island.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. Season 1 visits attractions from California to Rwanda, Switzerland, Iceland, Utah, Zambia, Mexico, The Grand Canyon, Georgia (the Eastern European one) Louisiana, Hawaii, Mauritius and Seychelles. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town!

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: Bangalore is a city with many names: the Garden City, the Pub City, the Fashion Capital the list goes on. Follow Bill as he journeys through this city of contrasts and touches on its many faces. We visit Cubbon Park and Lal Bagh Gardens, shop in the markets and explore the nightlife of the modern city. We also explore architecture, from ancient Bull Temple, the legendary source of the Vishva Bharti River to the largest legislative building in India. Bill's final stop is the "Queen of the Hill Stations" Ooty, where he tours the plantations, rides the historic narrow-gauge railroad and visits the Stone House, which was built by the British in the days of colonial rule.

programme.title: Journeys in India
programme.desc: These two national parks have some of the most diverse wildlife found on the Indian subcontinent. From the ancestors of our domesticated livestock to leopards, bear and elephants—this is a photographer's paradise. Join Bill as he attempts to track down two of the hardest predators to photograph—the leopard and the sloth bear.

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: All the essentials for going on, and having a successful safari are covered before our host gets a very special challenge—to find at least half of the "Big Twelve" on one safari drive. Four hours and six (6) very special animals—can he do it using his own rules for a successful safari?

programme.title: Journeys in Africa
programme.desc: We elect to stay on a few extra days to try and obtain some good leopard footage. These are the most elusive of the "Big Twelve" and filming them is a major challenge. In the process of tracking leopards, we run across a newborn gazelle trying to walk for the first time. Will it succeed before the predators find it? Can we find and film a leopard up close?

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Follow some of the biggest names in freestyle motocross as they prepare for the "Dew Action Sports Tour," being held in Salt Lake City.

programme.title: Nomads
programme.desc: Top pros and riders meet up for five days of racing in Whistler ski resort for the Crankworx Mountain Bike Festival.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: The question often rises is the cost of space exploration really worth it? Could the money be better spent elsewhere. If so one space program would have to remain. The planetary defence program, to locate identify and deflect a wayward asteroid from hitting Earth and destroying our civilzation because at last count there were 15,000 possible dangerous candidates close to Earth.

programme.title: New Frontier
programme.desc: For an instrument first developed as recently as the 17th century, the telescope has travelled a long way. The latest version of the once-humble telescope will be going a lot farther _ carrying us ever closer to the first light that ever bathed the Universe in which we live.

programme.title: Everyday Elements
programme.desc: A series that puts chemistry in our everyday experience by showing the living connection we have with the chemicals and elements that make up our world. The matter that built skies and seas, the atoms that make up you and me, the chemistry around us that forms the things we touch, smell and see. This series shows us what the objects in our universe and in our homes are made from and why the particles around us behave as they do. Everything around us is built from Everyday Elements.

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It was the purrrfect idea for making our furry friends more pleasant around the house! You'll learn how litty litter clawed its way into our homes. And you'll learn how a garment made out of special woven fibers can stop a bullet, plus, why is walking under a ladder bad luck? And finally, we'll "cut to the chase" and explain the history behind this common phrase!

programme.title: Wow, I Never Knew That!
programme.desc: It's the city of love, Paris, France. The world over knows its most famous structure, the Eiffel Tower! But did you know parisians originally wanted to tear it down! We'll explain why and how it was saved! Then, you'll visit America's first pizzeria! And how the gourmet ice cream Haagen Dazs got its exotic start in Bronx New York!

programme.title: Water: H2O Stories
programme.desc: Water: H2O Stories is a 3x52 series revisiting the story of water on planet Earth and its disrupted course over time which has led to the 21st century biggest challenge.

programme.title: Inside Outer Space
programme.desc: Come with us as we explore and unravel the mysteries of what lies beyond our planet Earth. This is a series packed with space stories and information about our universe covering what we can see, how we can live in space and what science tells us about the past and the future as we journey inside out of space.

programme.title: Nature's Force
programme.desc: Heatwaves have caused cities to literally meltdown and systems to fail, how are we working with nature's heat? When two Cyclones collide, we get the Fujiwhara Effect, how is this possible and how does it manifest? Floods occur around the world and the world is learning how to cope, combat and prevent damage and share lessons. How do you classify a Blizzard, and let's look at some of the worst blizzards that have occurred on earth. Do you really know how to measure Rainfall and how to identify violent rain from a shower or appreciate when we have had enough or too much?

programme.title: Quirky Science
programme.desc: Medical history is full of odd cures—like bloodletting, which still helps in rare cases. Germs were once doubted until a doctor spotted bacteria between his teeth. Fleming later discovered antibiotics by accident. But now, "superbugs" threaten this miracle cure. Refrigeration, once deadly due to toxic gases, evolved thanks to pressure-cooking and may soon use sound waves. From leeches to lab breakthroughs, medicine keeps evolving—what's next?

programme.title: Infestation
programme.desc: Our cities are being attacked, overrun and overwhelmed with pests and invasive species bent on decimating our homes and threatening our well being. What happens if these urban invaders continue to expand their territory and occupy our safe haven? Is it just a matter of time before an emerging deadly disease carried by one of those urban invaders creates havoc in our big cities?

programme.title: Music Voyager
programme.desc: Music Voyager is a music and travel broadcast series (television/cable, broadband, in-flight and mobile) that invites viewers to discover the exciting sounds of the planet. The host is Jacob Edgar, an explorer who does not search for lost cities or ancient ruins. He's on the quest for a different kind of treasure…music. As an ethnomusicologist and world music record producer, Edgar travels the globe hunting for the best songs the world has to offer, and he suffers through some of the worst…so you don't have to. Along the way, he's rewarded with a backstage pass to concert halls, street festivals, recording studios and rehearsal rooms. With local musicians as his guide, Edgar tastes exotic and occasionally ghastly food, visits off-the-beaten path attractions and parties the night away to amazing concerts at hidden venues that only the locals know. Join music voyager for unexpected adventures and surprising discoveries that unveil the magic, mystery and music of far off lands.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: Built in 1861 Mill Street Barracks is steeped in rich history. It has accommodated many branches of the armed forces throughout its life. Like many other barracks it has also been used as a morgue making it a prime location for the supernatural.

programme.title: Rip Files
programme.desc: The haunted Graffitti House dates from the Civil War and many of its previous residents still linger.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: What In the World
programme.desc: Presented by Peadar King, this series illustrates the human consequences of global economic inequalities and human rights violations, by focusing on how people encounter these issues on a daily basis.

programme.title: Desperate Hours
programme.desc: In this episode, we focus on nuclear and industrial disasters. Nuclear power, based on fission or fusion, is a clean energy source—but when safety fails, consequences can be catastrophic. Industrial accidents are tragic enough, but when natural disasters like earthquakes or volcanoes strike nuclear facilities, the results can be off the scale and last for decades. This chilling look reminds us that vigilance and responsibility are vital to prevent the unthinkable.

programme.title: RV Explorers
programme.desc: RV Explorers, chasing 100 Sunsets. A TV show following a new motorhoming couple as they explore the towns and regions of NZ _ experiencing various tourist attractions, events and joining in with other motorhomers to experience their favourite activities.

programme.title: The Past Hunters
programme.desc: The Hack Green Secret Nuclear Bunker is a former government-owned nuclear bunker located at Hack Green, Cheshire, England. It Started as a decoy site for enemy bombers but later developed into a legitimate base. Now it is ripe with hauntings.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray starts by hitching a lift on a research crane to get a bird's eye view over the Rainforest; from there, he can see the geographical position responsible for this lush vegetation: mountain range in the west and the sea in the east. He then goes down to the ground, delving into the heart of the jungle, he comes across millennial trees, camouflage spiders and a miniature dinosaur, the Boyd's Forest Dragon. He pursues his journey by travelling on a zipwire with wildlife expert, Justin McMahon. Together they observe life in the canopy. Meanwhile, Ray's cameraman Martin Hayward Smith has been filming an animal that can only be found in this part of the world: the Bennett's tree kangaroo, a cute marsupial that lives like a monkey.

programme.title: Wild Australia with Ray Mears
programme.desc: Ray takes the Great Ocean Road along the Antarctic facing coast of Australia _ the longest South facing coastline in the world. He starts in Port Philp Bay the entrance to Melbourne Harbour where for the first time he sees a strange marine creature _ the weedy sea dragon _ a relative of the sea horse. He also swims with a unique species of dolphin _ the Burrunan Dolphins.Crossing the Bay he heads off down the longest War Memorial in the world _ the Great Ocean Road and meets 93 year old Doug Stirling who remembers the world war 1 veterans building the road.Ray visits the Penguin Colony on Middle Island where guard dogs protect the penguins from foxes and he watches the night time return of the penguins after a day spent at sea fishing.He takes to the seas and discovers the creatures of the deep waters _ albatross, balls of krill and a pod of fast moving common dolphins.

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: As Loro Parque's head vet, Jorge never knows from one day to the next what will come through his clinic. From tending to oversexed otters, fine-footed flamingoes or armoured armadillos, a day spent with Jorge, is a day immersed in nature from the four corners of the globe. Ever seen a grown man hug a turtle? For Javier, Loro Parque's Head of Environmental Affairs, it's all part of the job! He's hitting the high seas of Tenerife with a turtle tracker in hand to help with scientific research _ but first he's just got to locate the turtle _ 2,000 meters down in the ocean!

programme.title: Animal Embassy
programme.desc: "Finding Nemo" may have brought fame to the striped clownfish but their newfound popularity has sent worldwide numbers into decline. Now we follow the aquarium team as they initiate their very own breeding program with the hope of finding many more Nemos to come. Jorge has got a 200-pound problem on his hands. Lin Mao the white tiger has something wrong with his hip and the vets need to make a diagnosis. Problem is, Lin Mao's not responding to the anesthetic Jorge just administered and he has to decide what to do next...very quickly.

programme.title: Meet My Wild Friend
programme.desc: Gasp at animal power, gawp at childhood innocence, this is the true story of children who live as friends with wild animals.

programme.title: European Islands
programme.desc: The European islands are renowned primarily for their hotel resorts. However, we will show you a completely different face of theirs: forests, beaches, coves, mountains, valleys and rivers. Perhaps you will find places that will take your breath away. Why just lie on the beach when there is so much to see? Put on some good hiking shoes, pull your shoelaces tight, and get to know the entire island like the back of your hand.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Outta Town Adventures
programme.desc: Outta Town Adventures travels both near and far to discover the best advenures the destinations have to offer. This TV series is dedicated to presenting history, culture and geography in a fun and pisitive way. It encourages people to explore this beautiful world _ something that starts with simply getting out of town.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: Some animals will never be inconspicuous, others blend so perfectly with their surroundings that they can move through them without detection. Camouflaged cats _ for many of the cats of Africa, camouflage is key to survival. From the spots of the cheetah, the rosettes of the leopard and the stripes and dots of the serval, these cats have evolved to merge with their habitat. Hidden Lizards _ Regal horned lizards vanish into Arizona's deserts, feeding mostly on ants. Cryptic Snakes _ Australia's death adder and carpet python hide in plain sight. Cuttlefish _ Change color, shape, and texture to disappear instantly. Chameleons _ Over 100 species, masters of rainforest disguise. Ptarmigans _ Snow-white birds of the frozen north. Crab Spiders _ Tiny hunters, perfectly matched to bark, leaves, or flowers.

programme.title: Wild Ones
programme.desc: The most venomous snake on land. The deserted heart of the Australian outback, where people seldom venture, is the hot, baked home of the most venomous land snake in the world _ the inland taipan, a two meter long snake with enough venom in one bite to kill a quarter of a million mice. Gila Monster _ North America's largest land lizard, venomous and striking, lives in desert regions. Blue-Ringed Octopus _ Tiny but deadly, it carries two venoms—one lethal to humans. Red-Back Spider _ Hidden in messy webs, the female's scarlet stripe warns of her deadly bite. Sydney Funnel-Web _ Aggressive and armed with toxic venom, the male is especially dangerous. Which venomous creature is the deadliest?

programme.title: Blue Realm
programme.desc: They're beautiful _ and deadly, with venomous spines that resemble a lion's mane. They're lionfish, a tropical reef species normally found in the Indo-Pacific. Now, they're wreaking havoc in the Caribbean and Atlantic _ all thought to have descended from a handful of aquarium fish carelessly released into the sea. In these regions, they are potentially a greater threat to coral reefs and commercial fish populations than global warming or pollution. In the Florida Keys, some practical and novel approaches are making progress in the fight against these Toxic Invaders.

programme.title: Sarah Shark
programme.desc: Sarah travels to one of the top 10 dive destinations in Australia (Julian Rocks, Byron Bay, NSW) to dive with three species of Wobbegong Sharks within the Cape Byron Marine Park. She also conducts a street poll with members of the public to find out what they think about sharks.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Nature's battletanks—elephants, rhinos, and hippos—dominate Africa. Elephants survive on plants, yet lions and hyenas target the weak. Despite their gentle image, elephants have killed rhinos in brutal clashes. Rhinos, around for 6 million years, are tough but endangered—man is their greatest threat. Hippos are aggressive and feared, even by crocodiles. But baby hippos are vulnerable if they stray from their mothers, making them targets for predators. In the Race of Life, strength and strategy are key to survival.

programme.title: Race of Life
programme.desc: Deserts are dry, extreme places with little rain and few plants. Semi-deserts support more life, but survival is still tough. Animals adapt to heat and water scarcity—some drink rarely, get moisture from food, or travel far for water. Many seek shade, burrow, or are nocturnal. Scorpions, ancient and armored, use pincers and venom to survive. Rattlesnakes, fast and deadly, are feared—except by roadrunners, who hunt them. Desert life demands resilience, cleverness, and unique adaptations

programme.title: On the Cities' Rooftops
programme.desc: How is life on the city's roofs? This series scales new heights, exploring apartment buildings, towers and monuments to discover a world full of unsuspected treasures : our rooftops. By day and night, the population changes on these heights. There are people who work here, people who live here, and others who come here to relax. The world's rooftops are a continual hive of activity.

programme.title: Dream Journey
programme.desc: February 2017 saw me embark upon a travel expedition through Scotland, Poland, France, Mexico, Belize and, (alas!), back. Not only was it the first time I ventured out to Central America, but also the first time I seriously pushed my bravery boundaries to do a whole lot of things I'd never tried before. I defeated my life-long fear of scubadiving and skydiving, (the Carribbean vistas do help! _ No danger I'd do that again in Aberdeen), I went zip-lining over a Mexican jungle, I tried habanero-packed streetfood, (failed at that miserably), and organic tequila, (managed that better;), I climbed a Maya pyramid in the middle of a Belizean rainforest and fed hibiscus flowers to a very extravagant donkey. Most importantly, however, I got to know some incredible people _ from shamans, wanderers and artists to refugees, businesswomen and expat cowboys. And thanks to aaaall of that, I also got to know a little bit more about myself for visiting the most remote corners of our planet reminds you how different and yet how similar we all are. I'm looking forward to sharing my incredible experience in 5 exciting episodes of our travel series, which really turned out to be a Dream Journey:) I sim
